array.string: mkdir -p /.dea/logs; if [ -f /.dea/logs/snapshot.log ] && [ "$(wc -c < /.dea/logs/snapshot.log)" -gt 1048576 ]; then i=6; while [ $i -ge 1 ]; do [ -f /.dea/logs/snapshot.log.$i ] && mv /.dea/logs/snapshot.log.$i /.dea/logs/snapshot.log.$((i+1)); i=$((i-1)); done; mv /.dea/logs/snapshot.log /.dea/logs/snapshot.log.1; fi; /fake/bin/dea snapshot --source dwh --source aws_main >> /.dea/logs/snapshot.log 2>&1
